name: Coca-Cola Consolidated - Erlanger Distribution & Sales Center, KY

fieldNotes.location: Roster lat/lng (39.0514,-84.6323) and roster address (600 Circleport Dr) geocoded to a street centerline in the Circleport office park near CVG airport - that area has only office/flex buildings, not a 300,000 sq ft DC. The real Coca-Cola Consolidated Erlanger Distribution & Sales Center is at 680 Erlanger Road (confirmed by company and city of Erlanger sources; 300,000 sq ft on ~32 acres, built on the old Showcase Cinema site, $30M / 430-job project by Hillwood + Al Neyer, opened ~2019-2020). US Census geocoder places 680 Erlanger Rd at the edge of a 3-building Hillwood commerce park beside I-71/75. The northernmost building (audited here, ~39.0368,-84.6098) shows red Coca-Cola Consolidated / Red Classic fleet vehicles and bobtail delivery trucks at its dock apron - the strongest match.
fieldNotes.buildingMatch: MEDIUM confidence on exact building. Three similar warehouses sit in this Hillwood commerce park; the audited building best matches the 32-acre figure and is the only one showing an active red Coke fleet. The other two appeared larger / lower-activity.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Single internal commerce-park access drive feeds the building's yard; the property is gated/fenced at the yard entrance. Gate hardware not directly visible (no Street View on park roads) - inferred from layout, low-medium confidence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No distinct beside-the-lane guard booth visible at the yard entrance. guardShack=false.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Truck gate present, no guard shack -> remoteGs=true (kiosk/badge check-in implied).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ - cross-dock layout with dock doors along the NW and SW building faces, trailers backed in along both. ~55 estimated; flagged as approximate.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on two physically separate building faces (NW and SW) suggest separate ship/receive flows.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Trailer drop area on the north yard holds 25-50 trailers without tractors; large fleet of red trailers and delivery trucks staged.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved yard and generous apron width provide room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; I-71/75 borders the site, no rail. railServed=false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky metro, directly off I-71/75 just south of I-275, dense industrial/commercial fabric - Urban.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal approach from the park access road to the docks holds 3+ trucks.
